sar.narrative: On 2016-11-21, customer C07297 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $482.12 (3476682). Internal investigation confirmed this transaction was part of a larger fraudulent episode involving three transactions totaling $1,427.12 on card C07297-K1. The activity exhibits a structuring pattern where four online purchases, each just under $500, were processed within 60 minutes. The transactions originated from a device profile (Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0) that has been linked to 295 distinct cards and 548 transactions over the past 120 days, including significant use of anonymous proxies. This behavior aligns with the 'card_not_present_fraud' typology and mirrors patterns observed in prior confirmed fraud cases CC-4348, CC-2440, and CC-1156. Given the exposure exceeds $500 and the customer has explicitly denied the activity, the card has been flagged for blocking per policy R4. The pattern of rapid, high-value online transactions suggests a coordinated effort to exploit the account before detection. We recommend permanent closure of the compromised card and continued monitoring of the associated device fingerprint.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded as the evidence confirms fraudulent activity consistent with card-not-present fraud, necessitating immediate card blocking and escalation.
